[[File:Trimpian.png|thumb|Trimpian served in a seasoned miasra sauce]]
'''Miasra sauce''' was a [[Color/Legends|yellow]]-swirled sauce that was considered the perfect accompaniment to [[trimpian]].

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Miasra sauce appeared in the video game [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a massively multiplayer online role-playing game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
